exposure: implementation of the new ACOG and SMFM guidelines
no implementation of the new ACOG and SMFM guidelines
outcome: Cesarean delivery rate during the second stage of labor
cohort: 11,464 women reaching the second stage of labor at term in a single university-affiliated medical center between 2010 and 2017
finding: The implementation of the ACOG and SMFM guidelines was not associated with a change in the cesarean delivery rate performed at the second stage of labor in the whole study population, but there was a rise in nulliparous women.
mod_finding: There was an increase in operative deliveries in the whole study population, especially in multiparous women, without an apparent increase in other immediate adverse neonatal or maternal outcomes.
